info.description: Ask a question of a workspace's warehouse, revise it by prompt, and follow the run live. A thread is one question plus its revisions; each revision is one run. Runs are asynchronous: creating one answers 202 with its id, and progress arrives on the run's event stream. Stages are not monotonic: a reconsider loop can start abstract again after validate, with the phase back at understand, and side states (clarify, ask, reconsider, restore) can appear as a stage. A run can go from complete back to queued under the same id (an answer to a beside-the-chart card, a chart switch); a run.status queued after running means a worker restarted it. Every error is a Problem. There is no auth in v1: calls are same-origin and carry no header.
info.title: sightline API

get.description: Server-sent events. Each frame is `id: <n>`, `event: <type>` and `data: <RunEvent as JSON>`; ids increase per run. Reconnect with `Last-Event-ID` to get only the frames after it (ids are per-run integers from 1, the same counter as RunView.last_event_id). A comment line `: ping` comes every 15 s. The stream ends after a terminal run.status (complete, clarify, failed, cancelled, superseded) or after asking.
